name: Stacked! Egg, Cheddar & Bacon Breakfast Sandwich or Smashburger on Potato Bun
whyItWorks: Served on a pillowy soft toasted potato bun with folded egg, aged cheddar, and bacon (or smashed beef patties), delivering savory protein without tough bread crusts or seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Breakfast Sandwich or Stacked Burger on the toasted potato bun with egg, cheddar, and bacon/beef only (hold raw onions, pickles, and spicy sauce).
watchOuts: Skip extra-greasy hash browns if your stomach is sensitive to griddle oil
